list_models: list all available AI models from the system configuration
get_model: get detailed information about a specific AI model by its name
create_model_response: create a ModelResponse with name, model, display_name, description, and capability flags
create_models_list_response: create a ModelsListResponse containing a list of ModelResponse objects and token usage settings
create_token_usage_response: create a TokenUsageResponse indicating whether token usage display is enabled
